acceptanceCriteria: A static check (vet-style test) fails when wire.Errorf(wire.CodeOf(err), ...) is reintroduced under internal/tasks/.
The check passes on the tree after #1430.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1432 (review-1021c, seal head 5cbdef8ac, base 0106d06cd). V1-2132 removes wire.Errorf(wire.CodeOf(err), ...) re-wraps that drop NotRetryable; PR #1430 adds wire.Annotatef at the sites V1-2132 touches. Expected: once #1430 lands, a static check refuses reintroducing the bare pattern. Actual: no guard exists. Sequence after #1430; coordinate with V1-2132 rather than duplicating its regression test.
title: Static guard for the wire.Errorf(wire.CodeOf(err), ...) pattern after PR #1430 lands (V1-2132)
